patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layout for content sections, featuring a very large, animating title on the left and supporting details or lists on the right.
Dominant use of extremely large, condensed, uppercase sans-serif typography for section titles, creating a strong visual impact and acting as primary navigation cues.
A stark, high-contrast palette of white backgrounds and dark grey/black text, with minimal, strategic use of a vibrant orange as an accent color.
Full-screen hero video that reveals on initial scroll, followed by sequential, full-width section titles that animate in from the left as the user scrolls, replacing the previous section.
Each major content block (Services, Works, Let's Craft) is introduced by a full-screen, dynamically animated typographic title, acting as a visual divider and focal point.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a full-bleed video that is initially obscured by a dark overlay and large text, then reveals the video content as the user scrolls down, creating a dynamic introduction.

Scroll-triggered animations are used to sequentially reveal large, full-width section titles (e.g., "SERVICES", "WORKS") that slide or fade in from the left, replacing the previous title, creating a strong sense of progression through the content.
The main navigation and a cookie banner remain sticky at the top and bottom left respectively, maintaining persistent access and information.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, condensed uppercase headings (~8-10x body text) with generous letter-spacing, contrasted with smaller, more widely spaced body and label text.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy and open, particularly in the hero and between major sections, creating a sense of spaciousness and allowing typography to breathe.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its dramatic, full-screen, scroll-triggered typographic animations that introduce each major content section. This bold and dynamic approach to content presentation, combined with a minimalist aesthetic, creates a highly engaging and memorable user experience that feels more like an interactive art piece than a typical marketing site.
